summary: The GenerateCourse module handles correspondence generation for courses and cohorts, allowing customization of outputs and managing recipient lists.
purpose: To generate course correspondence with customizable parameters for different user roles and scenarios.

workflows.name: Generate Correspondence
steps: Load page with initial settings based on request parameters.
Setup JavaScript variables for UI interactions.
Bind data to dropdowns for department, program, term, and date source.
Handle correspondence generation via cmdGerenate_Click event, adjusting settings based on user roles and selections.

workflows.name: Dropdown Data Binding
steps: Fill terms based on program selection.
Bind choosers with timetable course data.

business_rules: Outbox and FormalLetter settings influence recipient list creation and output format options.
System and local administrators control visibility and email functionality.
Dates for correspondence can be customized or based on scheduled cohort dates.
validations: Ensure valid selection of correspondence recipients.
Validate date formats for correspondence scheduling.
Check permissions for email visibility based on user roles.
calculations: Set correspondence date based on cohort schedule or user input.
Determine output format based on radio button selection.
conditions: Outbox mode affects PR selection and recipient list restrictions.
FormalLetter influences signature and contact info inclusion.
Department, program, and term selections control data binding.
system_behavior: JavaScript setup is triggered pre-render for client-side interactions.
Data binding occurs during page load and dropdown change events.
Correspondence generation triggers popup for recipient selection.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for user context and role management.
Database for date and correspondence information retrieval.
ASP.NET Web Controls for UI elements.
exceptions: No recipient list generation when PR is not selected in Outbox mode.
Error messages are added to UserSession when validation fails.
